intervals.label: preparation
intervals.note: See the experiment:cupid interval note. No source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) gives a physical-construction start date. `start` (2025) is the year of the earliest dated CUPID collaboration paper found, a lower bound and not a true start date.
intervals.quote: CUPID will profit of the established CUORE cryogenic infrastructure, and deploy ~1500 Li2MoO4 crystals in place of the TeO2 ones.

name: CUPID detector
notes: The cited sources confirm LNGS generally, not the Hall A designation specifically. CUPID is planned to reuse the CUORE cryostat, which the atlas places in Hall A (detector:cuore), but no source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) states 'Hall A' for CUPID verbatim; confidence in the placement is 'uncertain' for this reason as well as the unconfirmed construction timeline.

placements.note: The cited source states the general LNGS location, not the Hall A designation; see the record-level note.
placements.quote: It will be hosted by the CUORE cryostat located at the Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso in Italy.

isotope.note: Verification fix (2026-09-17): the previous `quote` ("Target Isotope: Molybdenum-100 (100Mo)") was not verbatim text on the page; replaced with the page's actual sentence naming the isotope.
isotope.quote: the candidate isotope 100Mo has a Q-value of 3034 keV (compared to 2527 keV of 130Te)

isotope_mass.quote: The CUPID crystals will be grown from molybdenum enriched to ≥95 % in 100Mo and cut into 45×45×45 mm3 cubes, corresponding to a mass of ∼280 g per crystal, or a total 100Mo mass of 240 kg.

summary.plain: About 1500 crystals of lithium molybdate, designed to both flash light and register heat when a particle hits them, planned to fill CUORE's existing refrigerator under the Gran Sasso mountain.
summary.technical: Planned array of ~1500 Li2MoO4 scintillating bolometers targeting 100Mo (Qbb = 3034 keV), to be installed in the existing CUORE cryostat at LNGS.

technology.quote: Li2 MoO4 is a scintillating material with a particle-dependent light yield ... In CUPID, the Li2MoO4 crystals are operated as cryogenic calorimeters, and coupled to a light detector.
